deck: Today's lineup features a strong mix of tribute concerts, holiday-themed productions, country music, gospel, and acrobatic spectacle as Branson's Christmas season programming begins in earnest.

shows.name: #1 Hits of The 60s

shows.name: Christmas In The Heartland

shows.name: Legends in Concert
shows.desc: World-class tribute artists delivering hits from icons with a special Merry Country Christmas theme including The Judds, Shania Twain, Toby Keith, Blues Brothers, and Elvis gospel

shows.name: Southern Gospel Sundays
